hypothesis: Inverse feature covariance emphasizes weakly observed/noisy directions; an identity feature metric yields more reproducible directional gain from the same full gradient.
controls: Same full51200-row score gradient, feature/whitened-mean coordinates, source policy, normalization and .01 current Gaussian KL; only preconditioning differs.
gate: Identity positive in>=5/6 independent cross cells, cross/fitting gain>=.1, mean independent gain>=2x inverse metric. Otherwise no GPU direction probe.
eigen_diagnostic: Split current-KL and independent projection at eigenvalue<=the already fixed ridge(.001*trace(C)/257); descriptive localization only.
scope: Cached readout geometry of one assisted policy; not evidence that production PPO/Adam has this exact failure or that natural gradients are generally bad.
